text: I'm so sorry to bother you this late. I'm a foster carer and I've got a 10 year old boy with chickenpox, he came out in spots yesterday. They're really itchy, but apart from that he's honestly fine in himself. His temp is 39.7 though, which seems high to me. I did the glass test on the spots and they all go pale, and he's weeing normally. He also hasn't been for a poo in 3 days and he's grumpy about that. Is the temperature ok with chickenpox or should I be doing something? Sorry again, I just don't want to get it wrong with someone else's child.
